shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
repeated horizontal ridged or banded lines
justification: Both are stone reliefs featuring a human-like figure and disc/roundel motifs with incised linear banding, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single, heavily eroded vertical monolith with crude, deeply weathered forms filling one block, whereas B is a crisply cut horizontal narrative frieze of processing figures and animals framed by rosette borders — different format, scale of detail, and quality of execution.
